cases.summary: User selects Upgrade Customer File from Customer Services
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open Customer Services. 2. Select Upgrade Customer File.
cases.expected: Upgrade flow starts. Profiles in the ticket: Freelancer, POA, Cash Point, Dealer Shop, Team Leader.

cases.summary: Only uncertified or rejected files can be upgraded
cases.preconditions: Uncertified or rejected customer; agent authorised; MSISDN active
cases.input: 1. Open Upgrade Customer File for that MSISDN.

cases.summary: Certified customer files cannot be upgraded
cases.traceability: SAA-919; REQ-003; Not Allowed — Certified customer files

cases.summary: Status screen shows rejection reason and missing or invalid documents
cases.preconditions: Rejected file with known missing/invalid documents
cases.expected: System displays rejection reason, missing document(s), invalid document(s). Examples: Missing ID, Blurry ID, Missing Contract.
cases.traceability: SAA-919; REQ-004, REQ-007; Rejection Information / Step 2

cases.summary: ID, Contract, Mixx indicators are green or red as stated
cases.input: 1. Observe ID Document, Contract, Mixx Subscription.
cases.expected: Valid: green check. Invalid/missing: red cross. Mixx is checked/unchecked, N/A for invalid.

cases.summary: Valid ID or contract is view-only; invalid can be replaced
cases.preconditions: One valid document and one invalid/missing document
cases.input: 1. Attempt to replace the valid document. 2. Replace the invalid one.
cases.expected: Valid ID/Contract is view only. Invalid/missing can be replaced.
cases.traceability: SAA-919; REQ-006; ID Document / Contract rules

cases.summary: Mixx originally subscribed is pre-checked; checking makes contract mandatory
cases.input: 1. Observe Mixx. 2. Uncheck. 3. Check again without a contract.
cases.expected: Checkbox is already selected. User can check or uncheck. If checked, contract becomes mandatory.

cases.input: 1. Select National ID, Passport, CEDEAO Card, Refugee Card in turn.

cases.summary: Unsupported document shows the quoted message
cases.expected: Message: "Document not authorised. Please use another ID card to register client." User must upload another document.

cases.summary: Status refreshes immediately; Confirm enabled only when complete
cases.input: 1. Upload a required document. 2. Attempt Confirm while items remain red. 3. Complete all items.
cases.expected: Added documents become green check and can be replaced using Cross. Missing remain red. Confirm enabled only when all required items are completed.

cases.summary: Mixx contract shows the listed fields and requires signature
cases.expected: Contract contains Date, Customer MSISDN, Customer ID Number, First Name, Last Name. Customer must provide signature. Contract is mandatory.
cases.traceability: SAA-919; REQ-012; Step 6 Mixx Subscription Contract

cases.input: 1. Submit. 2. Enter PIN. 3. Observe receipt. 4. Download. 5. Share.
cases.expected: Receipt: Certification Status On Going; Activation Status Sim Activation Activated; Message SMS will be shared to client, once certification is realised; Transaction ID. Download and Share are available.

cases.summary: Post-conditions: On Going, history, no stock/commission/performance impact
cases.input: 1. Check certification status. 2. Open history. 3. Check stock, commission, performance.
cases.expected: Updated documents submitted to BO. Status On Going. Upgrade recorded in history. No stock, commission or performance impact.
cases.traceability: SAA-919; REQ-015, REQ-018; Post Conditions / History Rules

cases.preconditions: Upgrade with a missing mandatory field or document
cases.expected: Mandatory documents, fields, document validation, and attachment validation from Customer Registration remain applicable.

cases.summary: New documents are added; existing documents are retained
cases.preconditions: File that already has some valid documents
cases.input: 1. Add a new document. 2. Inspect the customer file after BO receive.
cases.expected: Existing customer documents are retained. New documents are added to the existing file.
